corpus.count_policy: Targets/ceilings, not quotas. Do not invent filler to hit a count; stop expansion when coverage and failure-family discovery saturate.
corpus.uniqueness_rule: No case counts as independent evidence when only identifiers, numbers, names, postcodes or cosmetic wording change.

execution: CPU qualify all deterministic logic and branch diffs first
Use successive halving for model/config candidates
Use small-g until whole-node cost efficiency is demonstrated
Use Slurm arrays for independent shards
Repeat identical cases only for finalist variance measurement
Record Git SHA, model/config digest, corpus digest, Slurm job ID, runtime and allocation delta

statistics.rule_of_three_policy: Use only for zero-event estimates on genuinely independent Bernoulli-like cases; never apply across correlated synthetic siblings. Prefer per-family intervals and explicitly state assumptions.
statistics.selection_policy: Use development for tuning, selection-validation for tournament decisions, and hidden-final only after finalists are frozen.
statistics.model_judge_policy: Deterministic scoring for hard safety/action/privacy gates. Any model judge used for nuanced conversation quality must be calibrated against a human-adjudicated gold subset before influencing finalist selection.
